author: Network / Remote Access
short_description: VPN fails to connect, device certificate expired
text: If the VPN client reports an authentication error and the device certificate has expired, renew the device certificate. Updating the VPN profile alone does not help.

author: Messaging
text: Turn on the archive policy for the mailbox; it moves mail older than two years and frees space within minutes.

author: Identity & Access
text: Send the self-service reset link; the reset also unlocks the account. Do not unlock manually if the password has expired.
